summary:
ASTRA | Space Survival is an interactive game that helps young students learn about life and missions in space. We developed a simple space simulator where players become junior astronauts and explore the Moon or Mars.

Players complete different missions such as collecting samples, managing oxygen and energy, repairing equipment, and finding important resources. The game turns space science into a fun and interactive experience.

ASTRA addresses the challenge by giving students a simple way to understand the challenges astronauts may face during space missions. It is important because it combines education, science, and gaming, making space exploration easier and more exciting for beginners.
details:
ASTRA | Space Survival is an interactive educational space game designed to introduce students to astronaut missions and the challenges of exploring other worlds.

The player becomes a junior astronaut and chooses to explore the Moon or Mars. The player can move around the environment, collect samples, manage oxygen and energy, repair equipment, and complete different missions. These activities help players understand some of the tasks astronauts may need to perform during space exploration.

The main benefit of ASTRA is that it makes learning about space more fun and interactive. Our goal is to encourage students to learn about space science, exploration, and astronaut life through gameplay.

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js. We focused on creating a simple game that is easy to understand and play, while still including educational missions and challenges.

The creative part of our project is combining space education with a game experience. Our team considered simplicity, learning value, user experience, and the challenges astronauts may face during missions.
